name: UI
summary: Screens and overlays: main menu, lobby, race settings, the in-race HUD, and controller-friendly widgets (Stepper), and the pit wall (StrategistScreen: timing, gaps, pit windows, weather radar, team radio feed). Co-op pit wall roles (CrewConsole: pit crew and strategist panels around the zoomed-out 3D race, combined for 2 players) and quick team radio calls (TeamRadio). Intro screen (SplashScreen: key art and a GT3 pass-by), the main menu over a loop of race highlights (MenuBackground), the player's profile badge top right (ProfileBadge), and the driver's own HUD layout (HudLayout, saved in GameData.prefs["hud_layout"]) with a minimal co-op driver layout (GameData.prefs["hud_layout_coop"]) and its editor (HudEditor: move, resize, hide items with mouse and keyboard; F2 in a race or Settings > Gameplay over a preview race), and the driver's pit call menu (PitCallMenu: tyres, which tyres, wings, fuel, repairs when calling a stop in single player) and the pit lane guide cues on the HUD, and Settings (SettingsScreen: Gameplay, Controller with rebindable keys and buttons, Graphics, Sound, Garage, Debug, built from GameData.settings_catalog; SettingsRuntime applies them).
notes: Main menu scene: main_menu.tscn. SetupScreen: the controller-friendly car setup screen; SetupStore saves setups per car per track in user://setups/. First scene: splash.tscn, which goes on to main_menu.tscn. Menu media in media/ (splash.jpg, highlights.ogv; tools/record_highlights.sh films the highlights). PitPlanner: the strategist's pit stop planner (plan view of the car, per-tyre compound and pressure, front/rear downforce, fuel, repairs, driver change, box call; queued, then Send gives the crew the plan and radios it to the driver as a code pit_plan message with lines). CrewConsole, StrategistScreen and TeamRadio take mouse and keyboard first.
